It is: so that the death does not become nothing, turn the Beast's eyes this way for one second. Levi uses the one second they turn. He makes the conception of using it into short words. segments.en: The line of the charge covers fear with a shout. The shout that covers is a repetition of the order. The repetition is a way not to look at the empty saddle beside them. The way does not last long. Without lasting, stones crush the line again. Even inside the crushing, the Commander at the front does not drop his speed. The back that does not drop is the real thing of the meaning. The soldiers chase the real thing before they understand it. Chasing is half of today's hero.
